text_en: To the leader: according to The Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官，八度低音。

text_en: Help, O Lord , for there is no longer anyone who is godly; the faithful have disappeared from humankind.
text_cn: 上主，求你拯救，因为热心者已缺少， 忠诚的人在人间也已绝迹不见了。

text_en: They utter lies to each other; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
text_cn: 人们彼此言谈虚伪， 嘴唇圆滑，口是心非，

text_en: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that makes great boasts,
text_cn: 愿上主将一切欺诈的口唇除去。 把大言不惭的舌头剪除！

text_en: those who say, “With our tongues we will prevail; our lips are our own—who is our master? ”
text_cn: 他们扬言说：“我们以口以舌取胜； 有口有唇护卫我们， 谁能作我们的主人？”

text_en: “Because the poor are despoiled, because the needy groan, I will now rise up, ” says the Lord ; “I will place them in the safety for which they long. ”
text_cn: “为了贫苦者的委屈， 为了穷困者的叹息， 我要立刻站起──上主说： 将渴望救援的人救起。”

text_en: The promises of the Lord are promises that are pure, silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven times.
text_cn: 上主的圣言是真诚的圣言， 如同纯银经过七次的锻炼。

text_en: You, O Lord , will protect us; you will guard us from this generation forever.
text_cn: 上主，恳求你护佑我们， 由这一代常拯救我们。

text_en: On every side the wicked prowl, as vileness is exalted among humankind.
text_cn: 恶人在四周往来追踪， 实如令人生厌的毒虫。
